prompt_html: True or false: Each option strategy or stock and option combination has a unique profit and loss profile.
How best to define the Call/Put parity equation?
choices_html: The combined prices of calls and puts at the same strike with the same expiration always sum to the same value.
The prices of call options and put options the same distance from the stock price with the same number of days to expiration will always face identical premiums.
With certain available information, including the forward value of a stock’s price, the investor can efficiently calculate call and put prices.
